verdicts.reason: A: the can has been pulled apart. The cream circle backdrop is stranded and clipped at the bottom-left corner, and the can body is see-through apart from the SOLSTICE label. The NEW badge floats on its own, cut off from the product. The headline and subcopy are tiny and left-aligned while the button is centred, leaving large dead areas, but the product is at least still recognisable. B: the product is gone, shrunk to a speck beside the NEW badge at the bottom, and the cream circle is again clipped in the corner. The headline is small, and the top 40% of the canvas is empty orange, so the design loses its key image and reads as unusable.
